records.subject: Al3+, Ti3+ and Y3+ impurity cations
records.quote: Effect of impurity elements on the structural stability and electronic state in the fin iodide perovskite, which is useful for tuning carrier concentration to improve the thermoelectric performance, have been investigated using first-principles calculations.
